categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in cosmetics manufacturing, focusing on OEM and ODM production of over 1,600 types of products including basic skincare and color cosmetics. It operates solely in the cosmetics manufacturing segment after a 2010 corporate split that separated sales and real estate rental businesses into a new entity.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies compliant with CGMP and ISO 22716 standards, ensuring high-quality production. It utilizes specialized formulations for functional cosmetics such as whitening, wrinkle improvement, and UV protection, supported by continuous R&D and patented cosmetic compositions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are cosmetics brands requiring OEM/ODM manufacturing services, serving both domestic and international markets. The company’s products cater to various end markets including skincare, makeup, and functional cosmetics sectors, with a strong focus on domestic sales and growing export activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Eumseong, Chungbuk. The company serves domestic markets predominantly but also exports to overseas markets including Europe and the Middle East, accounting for about 7% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the cosmetics supply chain as a contract manufacturer providing OEM and ODM services. It sources raw materials and packaging components and manufactures finished cosmetic products for brand owners and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capabilities, enhancing product quality, and developing new formulations such as multifunctional cosmetics. R&D focuses on innovation in whitening, wrinkle improvement, UV protection, and scalp care products, supported by government-funded projects and numerous patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of manufactured cosmetics under OEM/ODM contracts. The company sells finished products to brand clients domestically and internationally, with no indication of subscription or licensing revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major Korean cosmetics OEM/ODM companies such as Kolmar Korea and Cosmax. The company positions itself as a leading Korean OEM/ODM cosmetics manufacturer with strong technical capabilities and a focus on quality and customized formulations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately 1,093 billion KRW in 2023, reflecting a 5.3% increase from the previous year, with operating profit doubling to 90 billion KRW. It maintains a stable financial structure with a current ratio of 185% and a debt ratio of 69%, showing steady growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality through CGMP and ISO certifications, customized formulations tailored to client needs, and confidentiality in client information. Its competitive edge lies in advanced R&D capabilities, diverse product portfolio, and ability to produce multifunctional cosmetics meeting global standards.
